event.title: SFSCON '26 - "From Right to Repair to DMA: Shaping the Open Source Hardware Landscape" in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: In the context of the upcoming compendium “Open Source Hardware in the EU Market”, Dario Presutti will briefly present in this talk how intellectual property rights, right to repair and the latest EU regulation on hardware interoperability shape the context of Open Source Hardware.

In particular, the talk will focus on the effects of the latest specification decision of the European Commission under the Digital Markets Act (Art. 6(7)) on hardware interoperability requirements for Apple and its impact on the Open Source Hardware market and legislative landscape.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 3.
